messages:
nina_acct_mgr: flagging an invoice issue from HorizonHealth — they were billed a full-month platform fee for cluster `hh-prod-03` even though it was decommissioned 2026-06-05. procurement put payment on hold.
audits-bot: Invoice #HH-2026-06 generated 2026-06-02 10:20 UTC. platform_fee: $18,000. cluster_tag: hh-prod-03.
kevin_billing: filing FIN-5077. Nina, do we have decommission confirmation? any change orders?
nina_acct_mgr: customer provided decomm ticket DECOM-4987 dated 2026-06-05 04:12 UTC and a deletion event in their console at 2026-06-05T04:15Z. They expect no charge after that date; invoice still shows platform_fee for whole June.
raj_engops: pulling billing events for hh-prod-03 for June. quick lookup: `SELECT id, ts, amount, note FROM billing_events WHERE resource='hh-prod-03' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' ORDER BY ts;`
raj_engops: results: bf-12211 (2026-06-01) platform_fee monthly $18,000; decommission webhook processed 2026-06-05 but the monthly rollup runs at 2026-06-01 00:00 which already generated bf-12211. The expected behavior is prorate on deletion and credit for unused days — looks like the deletion hook didn't trigger prorate adjustment.
kevin_billing: so monthly charge created before decomm, but we should have issued a prorate credit after decommission. Is there a missing billing adjustment event?
raj_engops: no prorate events found for bf-12211. Deletion hook logged but failed to enqueue billing adjustment due to a downstream timeout. Ticket ENG-BILL-234 opened.
olga_finance: Finance ok to issue a provisional credit for the unused portion while engineering backfills. Estimate: prorated credit for 25 days unused = 25/30 * $18,000 = $15,000. Approve provisional credit up to $15,500 for rounding. GL: CU-CR-DECOM.
kevin_billing: creating provisional credit memo CM-HH-2026-06-P for $15,000 and tagging invoice HH-2026-06 as disputed. Nina, inform the customer and include FIN-5077 ref.
nina_acct_mgr: draft msg: "We've paused collection on the platform fee for cluster hh-prod-03 and issued a provisional credit of $15,000 while we backfill the prorate. We'll confirm final numbers within 48 hrs and post the credit memo to the invoice. Apologies for the inconvenience." Approve?
kevin_billing: approve. Also note to procurement that decomm ticket was received.
raj_engops: backfill job initiated (backfill-hh-2195). It will generate prorate adjustment and post an invoice-level credit. ETA ~3 hrs. Root cause: webhook retry didn't handle billing service timeouts; adding retries and alerting.
raj_engops: backfill completed — created adjustment bf-12299 credit -$15,000. delta matches provisional credit. ENG-BILL-234 resolved.
kevin_billing: posting credit memo CM-HH-2026-06-1 for $15,000, attaching to HH-2026-06, invoice status set to adjusted.
olga_finance: Finance to post GL CU-CR-DECOM $15,000 once CM hits ledger. We'll sign off after ledger entry.
nina_acct_mgr: customer responded: "Thanks, that resolves procurement hold. We'll proceed with payment net of the credit." Closing loop.
kevin_billing: postmortem items: add retry + dead-letter monitoring to deletion -> billing path, nightly check for billed resources with deletion events, update runbook for provisional credits. Assign raj_engops and olga_finance.
olga_finance: FIN-5077 -> resolved. Thanks team.
